# Analytics Ascent

> Analytics Ascent is a small analytics team that builds models and browser tools for operations and regulatory data: DORA Register of Information checks, should-cost part matching, data cleaning, unit economics and company ownership resolution. The tools run in the visitor's browser and upload nothing.

The guides answer one question each and cite the regulator's own documents, named, linked and dated on the page.

## Tools

- [DORA Register Checker](https://analyticascent.com/dora-register): validates a DORA Register of Information against the EBA's validation rules, keys, foreign keys, closed lists and LEI check digits, in the browser.
- [Unit Economics Calculator](https://analyticascent.com/unit-economics): contribution margin, break-even volume, sensitivity analysis and a demand forecast.
- [Quote Matcher](https://analyticascent.com/cm-optimiser): matches a new part against parts already quoted and anchors a should-cost price to them.
- [Data Clinic](https://analyticascent.com/data-clinic): profiles a messy CSV or Excel file for duplicates, mixed units, decimal conventions and inconsistent spellings, and returns a cleaned copy.
- [All tools](https://analyticascent.com/tools): the hub page for the tools above.

## Guides

- [DORA register errors 805, 806 and 807 explained](https://analyticascent.com/guides/dora-register-of-information-validation-rules-805-806-807): what the EBA rejection codes mean, the key and foreign-key lists, and the resubmission order.
- [DORA Register of Information deadlines by NCA](https://analyticascent.com/guides/dora-register-of-information-deadline-by-country): 2026 submission windows, reference date, portal and file format for BaFin, DNB, NBB, CSSF, Central Bank of Ireland, ACPR, MFSA and FMA.
- [LEI or EUID for each ICT provider](https://analyticascent.com/guides/dora-lei-vs-euid-ict-provider-identifier): which identifier each ICT provider needs, including non-EU providers and lapsed LEIs.
- [DORA Register of Information templates explained](https://analyticascent.com/guides/dora-register-of-information-templates-explained): what goes in each template from B_01.01 to B_99.01 and how the tables link.
- [All guides](https://analyticascent.com/guides): the hub page for the guides above.

## Dataset

- [Really European?](https://analyticascent.com/really-european): who controls the products on Europe's five buy-European directories, each verdict tied to a primary document and a date; unverified rows say so. Markdown: https://analyticascent.com/really-european.md. Data (CC0): https://analyticascent.com/data/really-european.csv
- [Is it really European? checker](https://analyticascent.com/really-european/check): search a product or company for its legal entity, LEI, GLEIF parent and verified owner, in the browser. Markdown: https://analyticascent.com/really-european/check.md
- [DORA ICT providers](https://analyticascent.com/dora/providers): contracting entity, LEI or EUID, GLEIF status and renewal, GLEIF parent against verified owner, lapsed twins and CTPP roll-up for the providers EU registers of information repeat. Markdown: https://analyticascent.com/dora/providers.md
- [Who Owns What](https://analyticascent.com/datasets/who-owns-what): a company ownership dataset joined from public registers, with parent-company lookup, published with its uncertain cases and free CSV downloads.

## Optional
